name: civicdesk.dockets.search
description: Search proposed rules (dockets) by keyword, agency, period status and closing date. Each result carries the agency, the comment period with its closing time in the agency's time zone, whether it closes soon, and the member's own comments and draft on it.

name: civicdesk.dockets.get
description: Read one docket: the rule summary and supplementary information, the comment period with its opening and closing instants in the agency's time zone, extensions and corrections with their dates, the supporting documents, and the member's comments and draft on it.

name: civicdesk.dockets.documents
description: Read the supporting documents of one docket (id is the docket ID) with their bytes: filename, MIME type (UTF-8 text or text-based PDF), base64 and SHA-256, in the shape files.put and mail.attachment.add accept.

name: civicdesk.comments.validate
description: Check a comment before drafting or submitting it, without changing anything: length limits, the name a named submission needs, whether the docket's period is open now, and whether it would be a possible duplicate of the member's own comment on that docket.

name: civicdesk.comments.receipt
description: Read the receipt of a submitted comment (id is the comment ID): tracking number, docket, agency, submission time in the agency's time zone, how the member appears on the public record, and the SHA-256 of the submitted text.

name: civicdesk.comments.status
description: Read the current status of a submitted comment (id is the comment ID): received, posted, or returned with the agency's reason, with its history and the delivery outcomes of its notices.

name: civicdesk.comments.list_mine
description: List the member's drafts and submitted comments with their status.

name: civicdesk.comments.draft
description: Save a comment draft on a docket, or update the draft named by id. The draft is stored even with problems; the problems are returned so they can be fixed before submitting. Named submissions need a name; anonymous ones carry none. Errors: unknown_docket, invalid_state (a draft already submitted).

name: civicdesk.comments.submit
description: Submit the draft named by id to the agency. Requires acknowledged: true, the member's acknowledgment that a submitted comment is public and cannot be withdrawn. Errors: acknowledgment_required, period_closed (with the closing instant and time zone), invalid_draft (with the problems), possible_duplicate (a second non-supplemental submission on the same docket). Submitting the same draft again returns the existing receipt.
